name: 08065 · Palmyra, NJ
findings: ZIP 08065 (Palmyra) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (77%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08065 (Palmyra) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
